**DK27.2** is a medical diagnosis code used in the Danish healthcare system to classify an acute gastroduodenal ulcer accompanied by both hemorrhage and perforation [^src1]. Within the context of the national clinical quality database for [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (AFDK), this specific code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications [^src1].

Specifically, DK27.2 is one of the designated codes used to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src3]. Because anticoagulant therapies commonly prescribed for atrial fibrillation carry a risk of bleeding complications, the AFDK registry employs a comprehensive set of ICD-10 codes to capture these adverse events across different bodily systems [^src1]. DK27.2 falls under the gastrointestinal bleeding category (which spans from DK25.0 to DK29.8A), alongside other codes tracking intracranial, urinary, and respiratory bleeding events [^src1]. The consistent inclusion of DK27.2 in the methodology across multiple annual reports (2023, 2024, and 2025) underscores its importance as a standardized metric for evaluating the quality and safety of cardiovascular care in Denmark [^src1][^src2][^src3].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
